Public registers turned into reliable, structured data: native connectors with rate limits and caching, and a positive control before a "nothing found" is believed.

The concept behind it: [Public registry](@/glossary/public-registry.md).

Services that draw on it: [Corporate and counterparty due diligence](@/services/due-diligence.md), [Digital investigation and OSINT dossiers](@/services/digital-investigation.md) and [Insolvency, litigation and register change monitoring](@/services/continuous-monitoring.md).

Practised with: [CSS](@/glossary/css.md), [Ecto](@/glossary/ecto.md), [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Leaflet](@/glossary/leaflet.md), [MCP](@/glossary/mcp.md) and [Nominatim](@/glossary/nominatim.md).

Public work whose own words show it: [crisis-map](https://github.com/korczis/crisis-map).

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
